Use case

Use case · Jul–Dec 2025

Golden Sats Challenge

From first bridge to DeFi regular, on Bitcoin.

  • $100M+trading volume
  • 10,000+transactions
  • 40%on-chain retention, an all-time high for Rootstock

Most participants stayed active across all four seasons. Together with RIF Me Up: 35K+ transactions, 7,500+ unique wallets and 900K+ $RIF staked.

The challenge

Rootstock’s DeFi ecosystem needed real usage, not just awareness: people who bridge, trade, lend and stay active across protocols.

The idea

One campaign told as four chapters. Each season unlocked a deeper DeFi action, and loyalty carried over: Season 1 players started Season 2 with bonus tickets, and the bonus grew again in Season 3. Nobody walked away empty-handed, because every non-winning ticket could be redeemed for a share of the RIF prize pool through RootstockCollective.

What I built

I designed the campaign from the first idea to the last report: the name and branding, the season mechanics, partner selection and outreach, on-chain tracking, and day-to-day community management on Discord.

How it worked

  1. Season 1 · Swap & Supply (Jul 17 – Aug 4)Users bridged through Stargate, then swapped and provided liquidity on Sushi, Oku and WoodSwap, with boosted-APY pools.
  2. Season 2 · Lend & Borrow (Aug 4 – Sep 1)LayerBank took over, with a looping task for power users and bonus tickets for Season 1 players.
  3. Season 3 (Sep 2 – Oct 27)The same journey on Avalon, with a bigger loyalty bonus.
  4. Season 4 (Nov 3 – Dec 15)The whole ecosystem: Tropykus, Money on Chain, RNS and staking RIF on RootstockCollective. A volume multiplier of up to 2x rewarded the most active users, and the top wallets won stRIF and limited-edition hoodies.

Use case · IRL activations

RIF Me Up

From event selfies to on-chain RIF stakers.

  • 350+new RIF stakers
  • 20K+$RIF staked
  • 300+wallets holding $RIF
  • 30+RNS domains registered

Custom t-shirts with each builder’s .rsk name, the booth in full swing and the mascot.

The challenge

Events bring thousands of people to a booth, but few leave holding the token. The goal was to turn presence at an event into real $RIF adoption, staking and on-chain engagement.

The idea

Make the event itself the on-chain onboarding. A selfie with the team earned $RIF, staking it in RootstockCollective earned rewards, and minting an RNS domain unlocked merch with your own .rsk name printed on it. A physical hook pulled people into a real on-chain action.

How it worked

  1. Spread the loveTake a selfie with the Rootstock team, post it on X and tag Rootstock to earn $RIF.
  2. StakeStake $RIF in RootstockCollective to back builders and earn rewards.
  3. MintMint an RNS domain, share it, and get exclusive merch with that name printed on it.

Where it ran

  • ETHGlobal New Delhi
  • Buenos Aires
  • ETHCC Cannes
  • WalletConnect Cannes

My role

I led these first in-person activations focused on driving $RIF adoption, staking and on-chain engagement.
